data.content:
Implementation plan (effort 2, no child knots):

1. Add a schema-v21 local protocol-v2 outbox module with three bounded tables: an immutable outbox row keyed by event ID plus SHA-256 and canonical payload, installation writer epochs with current inbox head and sequence, and a legacy quarantine inventory keyed by path plus hash. The outbox row itself is the atomic pending receipt and event bundle. Duplicate event IDs must match the exact hash or fail.
2. Route App-authored EventRecord writes through durable recording before the compatibility event file is written and before any knot_hot, edge, catalog, or cache mutation. Preserve existing legacy files. On upgrade, inventory legacy event/index files into quarantine only; never enqueue them or delete them, so unknown authorship cannot republish replica history.
3. Add a credential-scoped inbox publisher that reads only pending SQLite outbox rows. It must never walk event, index, snapshot, archive, pack, worktree, or replica trees. Persist a random UUIDv7 installation writer epoch. Register its first inbox head and the new control record with one atomic Git push guarded by exact control-head and empty-inbox leases. Later pushes advance only that writer's inbox by exact expected-head fast-forward.
4. Persist the proposed inbox OID before network publication. Mark rows acknowledged only after fetching the scoped inbox ref and confirming that exact OID. A retry after a lost acknowledgement accepts only the stored OID and exact event-ID/content-hash bundle; mismatches fail closed. Rotate credentials by creating a new writer epoch/ref and registering it through a new control CAS.
5. Keep generation-two local deletion disabled. Never remove archives, raw packs, legacy events, indexes, or snapshots. Retain the existing fail-closed provider protection boundary and require a validated protection identity/control head for publication.
6. Test migration/idempotency/hash conflicts, crash points before and after legacy-file creation, retry/lost acknowledgement, writer rotation, control and inbox lease rejection, exact-path deduplication, and legacy quarantine retention. Add a two-clone bare-remote test proving each clone only publishes its locally recorded rows and cannot resurrect acknowledged compacted paths. Retain the actual v0.17.6 compatibility fixture.
7. Run cargo fmt, focused outbox/replication/compatibility tests, file-size checks, and make sanity. Publish an attributed commit on an isolated branch from main, then use the authorized GitHub PR, CI, Codecov, merge, main verification, and terminal Knots review rails.

Risks and controls: multi-ref registration must be atomic or fail closed; provider policy rejection is not retried as a merge conflict; outbox processing is strictly ordered per writer; all schema writes are additive and local SQLite only; no remote or local deletion is in scope.
